sloka: सर्वैः एव समागम्य वाक् इयम् समुदाहृता ।राक्षसैः दण्डकारण्ये बहुभिः काम रूपिभिः ॥३-१०-१०॥
transliteration: sarvaiḥ eva samāgamya vāk iyam samudāhṛtā ।rākṣasaiḥ daṇḍakāraṇye bahubhiḥ kāma rūpibhiḥ ॥3-10-10॥

translations.english: I enquired about what I could do for them. And all the brahmins in one voice said:.
